headline: Hwang Minhyun to leave PLEDIS after his contract ends Dec 14
sub: Agency says both sides agreed after long, careful talks
source: Source: Official statement from PLEDIS Entertainment
caption:
Hwang Minhyun is parting ways with PLEDIS Entertainment.

PLEDIS announced on Nov 28 that his exclusive contract will end on Dec 14, saying both sides agreed after careful consideration. He will finish his scheduled activities before then. The former NU'EST member debuted with the agency in 2012 and released his latest solo single 'OUR' in October.

📌 Source: Official statement from PLEDIS Entertainment
